author: Jeff Blume
text:
What a wonderful company. They were early and did a wonderful job in pumping the tank and explaining the situation to me. Brian did a great job in identifying and explaining everything to me And he and his assistant did all this with a tropical system going by.
Great company, great people, highly recommend them. Can’t thank them enough for helping people from Florida out.

author: Jack Fullerton
text: Highly recommend Hammond Septic Tank - Repair & Install! They came out today to pump our septic tank and repair our filter. They explained everything so I knew every step in the process. They worked fast, cleaned everything up so well you can barely tell they were here, and made dealing with a septic tank way less gross than I expected. Great people and great service! Thank you!

author: Wanda Crumley
text:
Coty Robertson and his team from HAMMOND’S Septic service are the VERY BEST! EVER! I used Coty about 19 months ago, perfect service pumping my tank! Today , I had a different issue, with a tenant. Coty worked me in!!  Super service!  I have used Hammonds for many years
(his father in law). They are amazing honest people. I know there are a LOT of  over priced, not truthful companies out there. Please don’t fall for unrealistic stories! I did once, but NEVER again! I will always use the reliable people.. people who we can trust!! Thank you Coty for your continued honesty and reliable service!! Thanks for SHOWING me the problem and explaining everything!
Wanda Crumley
Gainesville, Ga.

author: Greg Long
text: Outstanding Technicians on sight. Excellent staff and support from the office. Professional, provide all the information prior to beginning work, and provide an excellent document on the results of function of the septic.

author: Pam Rathbun
text: Excellent communication. Clear discussion of what they were looking for and the various solutions based upon what they found. They were professional, honest and will likely be the only septic company I will ever call. Excellent!
